thread:
Carmen Liu: Starting bring-up for apac-east1-gpu cluster (cluster-id: apac-gpu-03). Bootstrapping node-pool 'p100-pool' but ~60% of nodes report NotReady or kubelet CrashLoopBackOff. Seeing ENI attach fails and driver module errors. Can anyone triage?
Sam Patel: Looking. Saw similar ENI errors during eu-west bringup last month — could be subnet ENI quota or IAM for node role. Running quick checks.
Kai Nguyen: Logs from one node: 
```
Jul 12 09:13:22 node-17 kubelet[2345]: E0812 09:13:22.123456 2345 kubelet.go:223] Error mounting device: failed to get device plug: nv_peer.err: kernel module version mismatch
Jul 12 09:13:22 node-17 cloud-init[123]: aws-cni: attach ENI failed: RequestLimitExceeded: network interface limit exceeded for instance
```
That kernel module mismatch plus ENI quota looks bad.
Olivia R.: Confirmed node AMI is the new image built last night (ami-2026-apac). It was supposed to include driver v525 and kernel 5.15. But bootstrap logs show kernel 5.10. Might be an image alias mispointing.
Rajesh 'Raj' Kumar: Oof. I gated the AMI publish step but maybe the pipeline updated the alias after test. I'll stop further rollouts. Can we fallback to ami-2026-stable?
Maria Gomez: We also hit MTU issues across VPC peering when we tested networking earlier — packets getting dropped on large frames; CNI MTU default 9001 here. Might be causing connection timeouts to attach ENI in control plane.
Chris T.: Quick check: cloud quota for ENIs in apac-east1 is 50 per-subnet. p100-pool wants 64 nodes. If we create >1 subnet, might be OK but our terraform currently targets a single subnet. Need quota bump or split subnets.
Sam Patel: For immediate triage, suggestion: 1) Roll nodes back to ami-2026-stable 2) Temporarily reduce node count to 45 so ENIs don't exceed quota 3) Validate kernel/driver pair on a canary. Anyone want to run rollback?
Carmen Liu: Rolling back nodegroup to ami-2026-stable now via terraform: `terraform apply -target=module.nodegroup.p100` — will pause autoscaler.
deploy-bot: Deployment started: terraform apply for module.nodegroup.p100 (change: 1 resource).
Sam Patel: Also check IAM: node role needs `ec2:AttachNetworkInterface` and `ec2:CreateNetworkInterface` for ENI. I saw a denied call earlier in cloudtrail for nid-attach with error AccessDenied.
Kai Nguyen: Ran `kubectl get nodes -o wide` on the canary: node-17 now Ready after rollback to stable AMI. Kernel 5.15 and nvidia-driver 525 present. NV peer errors gone.
Olivia R.: I'll open an AMI publish postmortem with the pipeline owners. We need automated canary test that verifies kernel + driver pair and ENI attach under low quota.
Rajesh 'Raj' Kumar: For quotas: requested ENI quota increase with cloud provider — request ID Q-APAC-2026-245. ETA 3-5 business days. Meanwhile we can patch terraform to spread nodes across two subnets (short-term).
Maria Gomez: Patch ready: change var.subnet_count from 1 to 2 and include anti-affinity for ENI allocation. I'll push a small TF change to create second subnet in the same AZ if quota bump isn't granted.
Chris T.: Also noticed the CNI defaults to MTU 9001. Our overlay uses 1500 internally — we should cap CNI MTU to avoid fragmentation across peering. Filed an ops card to set MTU=1500 by default for apac-east1 clusters.
Sam Patel: Can we add a preflight validation to the runbook? Steps: check ENI quota >= desired nodes, verify AMI kernel == target kernel, validate node-role IAM, MTU validation between control plane VPC and worker subnets.
Carmen Liu: Agreed. I'll update the provisioning runbook and add these commands: 
```
# ENI quota check
aws ec2 describe-account-attributes --attribute-names max-elastic-network-interfaces
# AMI kernel check
ssh ubuntu@<node> 'uname -r; modinfo nvidia | head -n 5'
# MTU test
iperf3 -c <peer> -M 9000 -t 10
```
Kai Nguyen: After rollback, we still saw sporadic kubelet restarts on 3 nodes. Investigating kubelet config — looks like we need to adjust `--fail-swap-on` and increase `system-reserved` memory for GPU instances. Small tweak in kubelet configmap fixes that.
Rajesh 'Raj' Kumar: I'll coordinate with cloudops to avoid cost surprises: we temporarily scaled down to 45 nodes and cancelled preemptible pools until we have stable AMI. Expect lower throughput but stable bootstrap.
Maria Gomez: Pushing TF change to split subnets now (will create extra subnet in same AZ). Avoids waiting on quota.
Carmen Liu: Thanks team. Next steps: roll to stable AMI (done), apply subnet-split patch (Maria), add MTU change and runbook preflight (Carmen), open AMI pipeline postmortem (Olivia), monitor for 2 hours and report.
oncall-bot: Pager duty alert cleared: incident 2026-07-12-apac-gpu-bootstrap (severity: medium) resolved to monitoring.
Sam Patel: After 45m watch: nodes stabilizing, driver/nv errors went to 0, kubelet restarts dropped to 1 on canary. Recommend re-trying gradual scale to target capacity with 5-node increments.
Carmen Liu: Re-scaling in 5-node steps now, will call when we hit 60 nodes. :thumbsup:
Chris T.: Added card to infra backlog: ensure AMI alias is immutable until canary verification passes.
Olivia R.: Filed postmortem draft and linked logs. Will assign owners for pipeline patch and canary tests.
Carmen Liu: Closing thread for now — will re-open if any regressions. Thanks everyone. :heart:
